title: Runtime V7 Complete-Turn Human Response Evaluation
description: Cost-bounded, varied scenarios for reviewing complete customer-visible turns and transitions. Mechanical checks cover authority and structure only; Codex/orchestrator review owns naturalness, tone, and overall quality.

input_basis.source: Paraphrased patterns from the bounded Gulong ManyChat episode study; no raw identifiers or verbatim customer transcripts.
input_basis.privacy: No names, contact details, exact addresses, order references, or private URLs.
input_basis.causal_limit: Scenario outcomes evaluate response quality and safety, not conversion lift.

execution_policy.default: List or run one selected scenario. Do not run the whole pack during implementation.
execution_policy.focused_command: $env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'; $env:PYTHONUTF8='1'; $env:LANGSMITH_TRACING='false'; $env:LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2='false'; python scripts/runtime_v7_live_test_pack.py --pack test_packs/runtime_v7_human_response_eval_pack.json --mode live --scenario <scenario_id> --memory-generator heuristic --background-signal-generator none --image-evidence-generator none --lead-qualifier-generator none --max-model-calls-per-turn 8 --max-model-calls-per-scenario 16 --max-model-calls-per-run 20
execution_policy.full_pack_gate: Run once only after focused tests and the selected-scenario review pass, or before an approved release candidate when the change scope requires it.

scenarios.title: Specific Yokohama size and four-piece price
turns: good am po may yokohama 205 55 r16? hm apat
hard_fact_checks: Any product identity, price, total, or promo comes from current product-tool evidence.
A product or price surface is rendered at most once.
No stock, fitment, reservation, or installation availability is implied without its authority.
review_focus: one useful next step at most

scenarios.title: Goodyear request for a Mirage without tire size
turns: boss goodyear sana pang mirage g4, ano available?
hard_fact_checks: Vehicle-derived sizes remain candidates until the sidewall size is confirmed.
No SKU price or fitment certainty appears without current evidence.
review_focus: does not dump a broad catalog

scenarios.title: Budget but quiet options for 195/65R15
turns: 195 65 15 po. budget lang pero sana hindi maingay
hard_fact_checks: Presented categories or products use renderer-owned labels and current product evidence.
Only one active guided decision layer is presented.
review_focus: uses both budget and quietness context
does not prematurely ask for every booking field

scenarios.title: Fortuner fitment question followed by sidewall confirmation
turns: fortuner 2019 stock mags, anong tire size po?
chineck ko 265/60r18 pala yung nakasulat
hard_fact_checks: The first turn labels inferred sizes as candidates, not confirmed fitment.
The later customer-supplied sidewall size supersedes candidate context without rewriting history.
review_focus: natural acknowledgement of the confirmed size
does not ask for the size again

scenarios.title: Direct Double Warranty mechanics question
turns: ano po covered nung Gulong Double Warranty? pwede makita yung promo?
hard_fact_checks: Warranty mechanics and media come from the active reviewed promo catalog.
A generic warranty answer does not replace or expand the scoped promo evidence.
Any image URL and action are renderer-owned trusted catalog fields.
review_focus: answers the question before or around the image naturally
does not copy the whole poster into prose

scenarios.title: Deestone and Toyo pricelist with optional supporting warranty visual
turns: may Deestone or Toyo 215/65R16? send options and price po
hard_fact_checks: Pricelist facts come from current product results and are not duplicated in prose.
If Double Warranty is shown, it is the active catalog surface and is not presented as SKU fitment or stock proof.
Product selection remains the single active decision layer.
review_focus: supporting promo feels contextual rather than inserted
next step follows the shown choices

scenarios.title: Dasma installation question refined to Salitran
turns: may kabitan kayo near dasma? 185/65r15 yung size
salitran area ako
hard_fact_checks: The accepted location is not described as a confirmed partner or available slot without service evidence.
A satisfied city/location detail is not requested again.
Only one location/service choice layer is active.
review_focus: moves toward service one step at a time

scenarios.title: Saturday afternoon installation preference
turns: Continental 225/45r18 po, pwede install Saturday afternoon sa San Pedro?
hard_fact_checks: Date/time and service availability require current partner/slot evidence.
A selected or preferred slot is not described as reserved or booked before the authoritative action.
review_focus: asks only the next schedule or product decision

scenarios.title: BDO card and Pay Later question
turns: accept BDO credit card? pay later sana
hard_fact_checks: Payment option, method, bank, and installment facts come only from current payment or FAQ authority.
No payment, approval, or saved method is claimed.
review_focus: does not force a product intake first

scenarios.title: Delivery address correction before submission

conversation_history.text_content: For delivery po yung order, Calamba area.
Noted po. I can prepare the order details once the delivery address is complete.

turns: update lang, ibang address pala sa loob ng Calamba. hindi pa submit ha
hard_fact_checks: The latest correction wins and no stale address is restated unnecessarily.
The order remains unsubmitted and unbooked unless the submit tool succeeds.
An order summary is rendered only when a current summary ref exists.
review_focus: does not over-celebrate or claim success
asks only for the missing address detail if needed

scenarios.title: Customer questions legitimacy and asks for an agent
turns: parang scam kasi iba iba sagot. tao na lang makausap ko
hard_fact_checks: The bot does not claim that a human is already connected or assigned unless downstream evidence proves it.
No product, price, or booking sales pressure is added to the complaint turn.

scenarios.title: Customer returns to an older commercial-tire discussion

conversation_history.text_content: I can check current options once you are ready to continue.

turns: available pa kaya yun? tuloy ko na sana
hard_fact_checks: Old commercial context is continuity only; current availability and price require a fresh tool result.
The response does not restart with a generic welcome or ask again for known size/brand.
review_focus: moves to the next valid check

scenarios.title: Customer chooses the middle option in natural language
turns: 215/55R17 options po, mid range lang
yung pangalawa okay na sakin, saan pwede ipakabit near BGC?
hard_fact_checks: A free-text choice is accepted only when it resolves unambiguously to a currently visible option.
Product selection does not itself prove installation availability or booking.
The selected product is not re-asked and location becomes the next active decision only when valid.
review_focus: acknowledges the actual choice rather than a generic 'noted'

scenarios.title: First-turn physical-shop and business-location question
turns: hello po saan kayo located, may shop ba na puwedeng puntahan?
hard_fact_checks: Any online-first, head-office, warehouse, or over-100 partner detail the model chooses to use stays within reviewed operating identity; none is a required talking point.
No exact partner, area coverage, availability, slot, stock, booking, pickup, or unreserved walk-in service is implied without current authority.
The business-location question is not counted as the customer's own area and does not suppress a useful area CTA.
review_focus: welcome and answer form one natural opening
partner-network branding is integrated rather than appended
one useful area CTA at most

scenarios.title: Customer asks whether anyone can assist
turns: Hi, is anyone available to help me?
hard_fact_checks: A general assistance question is not treated as an explicit human-handoff request.
The response does not claim a human is online, assigned, or already connected.
review_focus: asks one lightweight question about the customer's need

scenarios.title: Generic assistance progresses through vehicle context to confirmed sidewall size
turns: Hello, may makaka-assist ba?
Need ko tires para sa 2019 Toyota Vios, daily drive lang. Around 12k sana for four.
Nacheck ko na, 185/60R15 pala yung nasa sidewall.
hard_fact_checks: The opening does not claim a human agent is assigned or online.
Vehicle and budget context do not become confirmed fitment or product facts.
The explicit sidewall size supersedes fitment uncertainty and is not re-asked.
review_focus: natural shift from generic help to tire discovery
uses daily-driving and budget context helpfully
one active decision at a time

scenarios.title: Comfort preference progresses from grounded options to area and schedule
turns: 205/60R16 po, comfortable sana pero hindi sobrang mahal.
Yung pinaka-affordable sa mga pinakita, okay na. Marikina Heights ako.
Saturday afternoon sana kung may available.
hard_fact_checks: Comfort and value are customer preferences, not unsupported attributes of a returned tire.
A free-text product choice must resolve to a visible provider-backed option before service progression.
The schedule preference is not described as booked and availability requires the service provider.
review_focus: acknowledges the selected option by name when resolved

scenarios.title: Vehicle estimate is corrected by sidewall size and relaxed brand preference
turns: Pang 2021 Ford Everest, BFGoodrich sana.
265/60R18 ang actual sidewall, all-terrain sana.
Pwede rin ibang brand basta same size at all-terrain.
Yung best value na option. Saan pwede ipakabit near Commonwealth?
hard_fact_checks: The customer-confirmed sidewall size supersedes candidate vehicle fitment.
The relaxed brand preference permits alternatives without inventing product terrain capability.
A best-value selection must resolve to a visible grounded option before service lookup.
review_focus: uses technical context only when grounded
does not repeat the old strict brand requirement

scenarios.title: Customer changes from nearby installation to delivery
turns: May installer ba malapit sa Festival Mall Alabang?
Actually delivery na lang sa Las Piñas.
225/45R17 Bridgestone sana, 2 pcs.
Tomorrow morning if possible.
hard_fact_checks: The explicit delivery correction replaces the installation path.
No installation partner or slot controls are shown after delivery becomes active unless the customer reopens installation.
Delivery timing, stock, and availability are not promised without current authority.
review_focus: asks only the next delivery-relevant detail

scenarios.title: Current promo and warranty questions progress into commercial-tire options
turns: Ano mga active tire promo niyo ngayon?
Yung Gulong Double Warranty, ano covered nun?
195R14C pang L300, budget option sana na may warranty.
Okay yung first option. Cavite City area ako.
hard_fact_checks: Promo and warranty facts come only from the current promo catalog or approved policy evidence.
The approved promo image may be rendered without duplicating its full copy in prose.
Warranty interest is a preference until a returned product or promo explicitly supports it.
review_focus: image and caption feel like one response
selected product remains clear when moving to location

scenarios.title: Installment question precedes product and payment-option selection
turns: Pwede BDO card installment 6 months?
195/65R15 for Corolla Altis, four pieces.
Midrange option lang sana.
Pay Later na lang if available.
hard_fact_checks: Payment support and brand eligibility come only from active checkout or payment-policy authority.
The initial payment inquiry does not become a selected method or approved installment.
A later payment-option choice cannot submit, book, or collect payment.
review_focus: answers the payment question directly without derailing discovery
retains useful bank and term context
does not repeat payment policy unnecessarily
progresses one stage at a time

scenarios.title: Returning customer changes the historical tire size before continuing

conversation_history.text_content: Sige po, message lang kayo when ready para ma-check natin ulit ang current options.

turns: Available pa kaya yung Cooper option natin?
Correction, 235/70R16 pala yung current size.
Two pieces lang, installation around San Pedro Laguna.
hard_fact_checks: Historical price, stock, and availability are not reused as current truth.
The latest explicit tire-size correction supersedes the old size everywhere.
The response does not restart with a first-turn welcome or ask for already known brand context.
review_focus: does not resurface the old size
moves naturally toward current product and service checks

scenarios.title: Customer excludes an origin, compares tiers, and settles on one option
turns: 215/60R17, affordable options po.
Pass muna sa China-made.
Compare natin economy at midrange, ano practical difference?
Midrange na lang. Kapitolyo Pasig ako.
hard_fact_checks: The origin exclusion filters later product results without becoming a disparaging claim.
Comparisons use only attributes supported by current product evidence.
The settled tier or product choice supersedes the earlier open comparison.
review_focus: location transition follows the settled choice

scenarios.title: Limited-stock FAQ interrupts and then resumes product selection
turns: 185/65R14 options for Kia Picanto please.
What does limited stocks mean?
Okay balik tayo, yung second option sa list.
Install sana around Sucat Muntinlupa.
hard_fact_checks: The direct FAQ is answered without turning it into a stock guarantee or replacing product state.
The resumed product reference must resolve to the still-valid visible presentation.
Installation availability requires a current service result.
review_focus: resumes without repeating the full list
maintains coherent context across the topic shift

scenarios.title: A confused late-stage customer asks for a human after inconsistent pricing

conversation_history.text_content: I can recheck the current product and installation details before we proceed.

turns: Bakit iba na naman yung price? Nalilito na ako.
Tao na lang please.
hard_fact_checks: The bot does not defend, invent, or restate a price without current product evidence.
The explicit handoff request does not claim that a human is already assigned or connected.
No further sales CTA is added after the handoff request.
